content: Upstream requirements: RS_Arti_00030 The OS shall create events that follow the state machine defined in the classes AR_CP_OSARTI_TASK or AR_CP_OS_TASK. Both classes may be used for task- level tracing, with AR_CP_OSARTI_TASK being preferred due to its extended tracing capabilities.
The OS shall create events of class AR_CP_OS_TASK to allow tracing of Task s.
